title: Factory v0.4 Decision Matrix
evidenceBase: FACTORY-EVAL-8 independent comparison: Factory Lite 94 > Role-Agent 93 > Vanilla 86

decisions.evidence: Core to all Factory runs. Global rules (anti-overengineering, security, UI quality) applied in all three runs.
decisions.benefit: Prevents common mistakes without process overhead
decisions.overhead: Negligible — read once at session start
decisions.risk: Constitution may grow too long and be ignored
decisions.defaultUse: Loaded at start of every Factory-assisted session
decisions.v04Action: Keep as-is. Review constitution length periodically.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Both Factory runs benefited. Prevents scope leakage. Low overhead (~100ms).
decisions.benefit: Routes work to correct role/task; prevents scope creep
decisions.risk: Over-routing simple tasks adds friction
decisions.v04Action: Keep as default core mechanism.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Both Factory runs used POR. Ensures agent reads requirements before building.
decisions.risk: POR may become ritual without actual reading
decisions.v04Action: Keep as default. Add spot-check mechanism to verify actual reading.

decisions.evidence: Related to Manual Router + POR. Works as a pre-condition check.
decisions.benefit: Blocks work until prerequisites are read
decisions.risk: Gate may be bypassed if not enforced
decisions.defaultUse: Integrated into Manual Router ROUTE-4 step
decisions.v04Action: Keep integrated into Manual Router.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Critical for separating process evidence from product evidence. Prevents counting process artifacts as quality.
decisions.benefit: Prevents false confidence from process artifacts
decisions.risk: Over-classification may become its own process theater
decisions.v04Action: Keep. Simplify classification tiers.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Critical for multi-run benchmarks. All three runs tracked contamination.
decisions.risk: Logging without enforcement is documentary only
decisions.v04Action: Keep. Active in multi-run contexts.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: 36 negative controls verified. Essential for benchmark integrity.
decisions.benefit: Prevents evaluation gaming (fake tests, placeholder features, etc.)
decisions.risk: Controls may not catch novel gaming strategies
decisions.v04Action: Keep. Expand as new gaming patterns discovered.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: 100-point rubric produced clear, defensible comparisons. But only needed for benchmark/comparison contexts.
decisions.overhead: Significant — requires code inspection, evidence gathering
decisions.risk: Rubric may become checkbox exercise without real inspection
decisions.conditionalUse: For important projects: use simplified rubric (pass/fail per FR)
decisions.v04Action: Keep as optional. Default: simplified pass/fail. Benchmark: full 100-point.

decisions.evidence: Not directly tested in EVAL-8 but essential for session management.
decisions.benefit: Prevents context overflow in long sessions
decisions.risk: Overly aggressive budgeting may interrupt useful work
decisions.v04Action: Keep as passive mechanism. Do not make it interrupt work.

decisions.mechanism: Context OS / Agent OS Event Bus
decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Not tested. The 10-role model attempted agent management but the event bus layer was not evaluated independently.
decisions.risk: Becomes its own system before demonstrating value
decisions.conditionalUse: Revisit if multi-agent experiments show need
decisions.v04Action: Defer to post-v0.4. Do not include in core.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Not tested in benchmark context.
decisions.risk: Adds complexity without proven benefit
decisions.v04Action: Defer. Evaluate separately from Factory core.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Not tested. Unclear benefit for project building.
decisions.risk: Autonomous agent acting without human oversight
decisions.v04Action: Defer to user-facing feature, not Factory mechanism.

decisions.evidence: Not tested in EVAL-8 but useful for long-running sessions.
decisions.risk: May rotate sessions unnecessarily
decisions.v04Action: Keep as optional. Simplify triggers.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Role-Agent (93) scored lower than Factory Lite (94) with 7.8x overhead. 10 roles for 11-FR project is excessive.
decisions.risk: Process theater: creating process artifacts instead of product quality
decisions.conditionalUse: Only for projects with >20 FRs or explicit multi-agent infrastructure
decisions.v04Action: CUT from default. Archive as reference pattern.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8 recommendation: replace 10-role with 3-role (Architect, Builder, Reviewer).
decisions.benefit: Lightweight role separation without excessive overhead
decisions.risk: Still adds overhead vs no-role (Vanilla) approach
decisions.defaultUse: Optional — activate for projects where role separation adds value
decisions.conditionalUse: Activate when: project has auth/RBAC, multiple data entities, or UI+API layers
decisions.v04Action: Design as optional pattern. Not forced.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Contracts added process artifacts without quality benefit in single-agent context.
decisions.benefit: Clarity when multiple agents work independently
decisions.risk: Contract creation becomes substitute for actual integration
decisions.conditionalUse: Only when multiple agents independently write to same codebase
decisions.v04Action: Defer to multi-agent projects only.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Drift detection logged but did not prevent drift. Documentary, not preventive.
decisions.risk: Logging drift without preventing it adds process without value
decisions.conditionalUse: Revisit when prevention mechanism is designed
decisions.v04Action: Defer. Needs prevention, not just logging.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Profiles defined for 10 roles but for single-agent context, skill routing is implicit.
decisions.benefit: Clear skill boundaries for multi-agent systems
decisions.risk: Profiles constrain flexibility without adding value in single-agent
decisions.conditionalUse: Only when 3-role or multi-agent models are active
decisions.v04Action: Defer. Tie to role model activation.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: 5 implementation roles for a monolith is over-segmentation. Single Builder role sufficient.
decisions.risk: Fragments simple work unnecessarily
decisions.conditionalUse: Merge into Builder role in 3-role model
decisions.v04Action: CUT from default. Fold into Builder.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Verifier checked process compliance but added separate role overhead. EVAL-8 evaluator was more effective as merged Reviewer.
decisions.risk: Verifier checking verifier = infinite regress
decisions.conditionalUse: Standalone Verifier only for formal benchmark evaluations
decisions.v04Action: REWORK: merge Verifier into Reviewer role in 3-role model.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: Auditor checked evidence chains but overlap with Verifier is significant.
decisions.risk: Duplicates Verifier work in single-agent context
decisions.v04Action: REWORK: merge Auditor into Reviewer role.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8 recommendation: merge Verifier + Auditor + QA into single Reviewer.
decisions.benefit: Single review role covers testing, verification, and audit
decisions.risk: Merged role may become too broad
decisions.conditionalUse: Scope-limited: Reviewer tests, verifies process, and audits evidence — does NOT write implementation
decisions.v04Action: Design as core of 3-role model.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: 8 handoffs with evidence paths for single-agent build is process theater.
decisions.risk: Handoff ceremony replaces actual communication
decisions.defaultUse: Lighter format: single JSON with artifacts list, POR receipt, and contract reference
decisions.conditionalUse: Full format only for multi-agent handoffs
decisions.v04Action: REWORK: simplify to minimal format. One handoff per role transition, not per artifact.

decisions.evidence: EVAL-8: ZIP packaging not evaluated. User confirmation required per rules.
decisions.risk: Premature packaging locks in untested mechanisms
decisions.conditionalUse: Only with explicit user confirmation after v0.4 review
decisions.v04Action: Defer to post-v0.4 user decision.

decisions.evidence: Not tested in EVAL-8. Skills are a Codex capability, not Factory-specific.
decisions.risk: Minimal — optional feature
decisions.defaultUse: Available but not activated by default
decisions.v04Action: Keep as optional utility. Not a Factory mechanism proper.
